summary.title: Patient summary
summary.deterministic: Built directly from the record: nothing here is written by AI.
summary.noMedicines: No active medicines in the record
summary.adherence: Doses taken: {{pct}}% in the last {{days}} days ({{missed}} missed)
summary.labsNeedServer: Lab values load from the server. Connect to see them.
summary.aiLabel: AI draft — verify against the record
summary.aiFootnote: Written by AI only from the facts above. It may leave things out. Check the record before acting.
summary.aiRejected: The AI draft mentioned something that is not in the record, so it was not shown. Use the summary above.
summary.aiUnavailable: The AI draft is not available right now. The summary above is complete.
summary.aiNeedsServer: The AI draft needs the server. Check the connection and try again.

timeline.title: Clinical timeline
timeline.empty: Nothing to show for this filter.

labs.title: Lab results over time
labs.empty: No lab values yet. Type them from a report to compare over time.
labs.needServer: Lab values are kept on the server. Connect to see or add them.
labs.unavailable: Lab values cannot be saved on this server yet (the lab table is not set up).
labs.rangeNote: Reference ranges are from the report or adult defaults (pregnancy where known); labs differ. Needs clinical review.
labs.add: Add lab values from a report
labs.errorDate: Enter the report date as YYYY-MM-DD.
labs.errorEmpty: Add at least one value first.

notes.title: Dictate consultation notes
notes.body: Speak in any language. The AI drafts the note below; you check and edit every field. Nothing is saved until you press Approve and save.
notes.transcriptHint: Your words appear here. You can also type.
notes.draft: Fill the note from this transcript
notes.drafted: Draft filled in below. Check every field before saving.
notes.noModel: The AI note service is not set up on this server. Type the note yourself.
notes.unparseable: The AI could not structure this dictation. Try again or type the note.
notes.needServer: Drafting needs the server. Check the connection and try again.
notes.sttFailed: Speech could not be transcribed. Try again or type.

form.fromDictation: Filled from dictation: check every field
form.otherLab: Other lab order (type and press done)
form.approveNote: Saving records this note in your name and sends the prescription to the patient's reminders. Nothing was saved before this.

rx.generic: Jan Aushadhi generic: {{name}}, ₹{{ja}} vs about ₹{{brand}} branded ({{pack}}). Demo prices.
rx.listNote: Medicine list: NLEM 2022 (needs clinical review). Warnings are a check, not a decision.
rx.pregnantToggle: Pregnancy status for the safety check

warn.none: No allergy, interaction or pregnancy warnings from the copilot's lists. This is not a full check.
warn.title: {{count}} warning(s) to review
warn.review: Warnings never block on their own: you decide. Tick each one to confirm you have read it.
warn.mustAck: Review each warning and tick “I have reviewed this” before saving.

priority.explain: Ranked by: risk severity from the ASHA risk rules (critical, high, medium, low), urgency, pregnancy with high BP danger signs, not yet seen, and waiting time. A guide, not a triage decision.
